description.summary: Reranking reorders retrieved candidates before context assembly so the RAG pipeline can prioritize more relevant context.
description.description: Reranking is a RAG technique that takes an initial set of retrieved candidates and applies a second ranking step before the final context is assembled for generation.
description.problemStatement: Initial retrieval may return a broad candidate set whose top order is not aligned with the final generation need.
description.coreIdea: Score retrieved candidates with an additional ranking method and pass the reordered subset to context assembly.

inputRequirements.name: Retrieved candidates
inputRequirements.description: A candidate set returned by an upstream retrieval stage.

outputArtifacts.name: Reranked candidates
outputArtifacts.description: A reordered candidate set prepared for context assembly.

implementationConsiderations: Limit the candidate set passed to the reranking step to keep latency and cost bounded.
evaluationGuidance: Evaluate whether reranking improves the quality of the final selected context compared with the initial retrieval order.
